name: 화산총독 카르도
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original magma commander boss game illustration using the input ONLY for its broad composition and illustrative treatment. Completely redesign the character, clothing, chair and setting details.
Maintain the reference landscape 5:4 canvas: stern mature man seated centrally and slightly low in an imposing chair, one leg crossed over the other, entire body including shoes visible, warm brown shadowed room, volcanic smoke around the chair and glowing embers near the floor. Crisp hand-drawn 2D anime outlines, solid cel shading, readable strong shapes; preserve the commanding seated mood and framing rather than changing to a heroic standing portrait.
New character KARDO: bald stocky older man with a broad jaw, rich copper skin and a short dark horseshoe moustache connecting to a neat goatee, one thin pale scar along his chin, ordinary dark eyes. No baseball cap, flower badge, reference face or military coat. His bespoke outfit is a fitted burgundy high-collar industrial magistrate coat with black basalt protective panels, a wide matte bronze belt, charcoal trousers, heavy black engineer boots and copper heat-sink wrist cuffs. Shoulders naturally broad, no gold epaulettes, no draped white cape. Both arms are folded across his chest, one gloved hand gripping a basalt command baton. He sits on a distinct squat angular obsidian throne with red mineral seams, no golden curled throne. Background a stone furnace council chamber with dim pipe silhouettes; curled smoke behind shoulders, orange magma glow kept low around the boots and chair base. No celebrity likeness or identifiable fictional character features.
One landscape 5:4 illustration, opaque full background. No reused pixels or exact tracing, no text, border, watermark, logo or numerals. Normal proportions, no compressed face, hands anatomically sound, continuous natural facial hair.
referenceRole: Composition, framing, illustrative treatment and broad atmosphere only; never existing character identity.
